judged.what: He drives all the way to the end of the level only to crash directly into the finish line wall, resulting in a 'DELIVERY FAILED!' screen as he says, 'Yep, I failed. That is crazy. Died on the finish line.'
judged.reason: Failing right at the finish line is a funny gameplay moment, but his reaction is relatively subdued rather than a memorable burst of outrage or humor.
